            function getTimeAgo(datetime) {
                if (!datetime) return '';

                const published = new Date(datetime).getTime();
                const now = new Date().getTime();
                const diffInSeconds = Math.floor((now - published) / 1000);

                // Halaman Voice of Indonesia memakai label berbahasa Inggris
                const isEnglishPage = false;

                const intervals = [
                    ['tahun', 'year', 31536000],
                    ['bulan', 'month', 2592000],
                    ['minggu', 'week', 604800],
                    ['hari', 'day', 86400],
                    ['jam', 'hour', 3600],
                    ['menit', 'minute', 60],
                    ['detik', 'second', 1]
                ];

                for (let [unitId, unitEn, seconds] of intervals) {
                    const interval = Math.floor(diffInSeconds / seconds);
                    if (interval >= 1) {
                        return isEnglishPage
                            ? interval + ' ' + unitEn + (interval > 1 ? 's' : '') + ' ago'
                            : interval + ' ' + unitId + ' yang lalu';
                    }
                }
